description: Cave site which produced an assortment of Roman finds dated between the 1st - 3rd CE. Some evidence of metal smelting, and the excavator characterised the site as domestic, but some have suggested a votive character to the site. This seems unconvincing, but the RSRB has marked it as a 'shrine' because of these suggestions.
